infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nino uses your photo library to choose profile pictures and local-only posts.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nino uses your camera to capture posts and stream live broadcasts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nino uses your microphone to record videos and stream live broadcasts.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nino to use your camera for live broadcasts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nino to use your microphone for live broadcasts.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Nino to select photos and videos for local-only posts and profile pictures.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nino to capture photos and videos and stream live broadcasts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nino to record audio and stream live broadcasts.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nino to use your camera to capture posts and stream live broadcasts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nino to record video audio and stream live broadcasts.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Nino to identify the country where you record a video for country Discover. Only the country and recording time are saved, never coordinates. You can decline and still record and post.
